answer: Give an AI key one weekly bid for ocean relic mapping from nadir images only if 10 of a fixed 1,000 endorsement units are bound exclusively to it that week. Validators check trustee signatures and reject bids with missing or reused units. New keys mint nothing: n eligible keys tie up 10n units, limiting eligibility to 100. The cost is forgone endorsement capacity, not a fee; units return next week. This is permissioned Sybil resistance: it trusts the initial allocation and no-mint rule, and captured trustees can give one owner the whole pool.
